reference_note: Faithful vector reproduction of the source page (source colours as a viewer shows them, original copy including typos). Hidden leftovers are listed under omitted.
omitted: 10 percent opacity group (form XObject Fm0, graphics state GS1 at 10 percent, bbox x -514 to 481 mm, y -81 to 245 mm, mostly off the page): the form content stream is empty (length 0), it draws nothing, so there is nothing to reproduce (the reference has no ink from it). Probably a leftover of a deleted watermark or beeldmerk copy.

notes: 480 x 240 mm sign, no bleed and no BleedBox in the source (page = trim, art is the full navy field only); the template adds 3 mm bleed (viewBox 486 x 246). Navy: the source is CMYK 100/86.3/21.5/3.5 (viewer #204382, the same drifted blue as the diefstal sticker), the template uses the token #1A3580. Logo: py-atom-logo-horizontal-white at scale 1.155 (beeldmerk 27.7 x 33.4 mm at x 178.6, y 25.5), the logo block is centred on the sign (beeldmerk and wordmark together, x 178.6 to 299.7 mm). Text: three lines of live Ubuntu Regular 98 pt = 34.57 mm white, baselines 114.47, 156.78 and 199.10 mm (pitch 42.3 mm = 1.22 x the size), centred on x 240 (the source centres the lines 0.2 to 1.2 mm right of 240 because the typed trailing spaces are counted; the template centres the ink). The keyword in Ubuntu Bold in the sampled light aqua #68CBDA (CMYK 54/0/14/0, no token, kept as sampled, same colour as the icons on the laadkabel and diefstal stickers). Variables: line-1, line-2, line-3-lead, keyword, line-3-end (line 3 is one text element with three runs, start anchored at the x that centres the example; recentre it when the keyword changes). Mounting holes: two 1 pt magenta rings (#ED308A, CMYK 0/93.4/7.2/0, an ordinary process colour and NOT a spot like ThruCut), diameter 3.7 mm, centres x 150.05 and 329.95 mm, y 126.70 mm (each 90 mm left and right of the centre line). They are kept in the reference. In the template they are the named group mounting-holes (stroke #ED308A, 1 pt, no fill). ASSUMPTION: their purpose (mounting hole marks for the barrier sign) is not stated in the file; the owner must confirm whether they print, cut or are only guides. No cut contour (none in the source, the sign is not a die cut shape).
